svg.title: Test beats training only when training runs through the mask
svg.desc: Twenty rows, seeds 0 to 4 in four groups: no dropout layer and Layer_Dropout at p = 0.1, 0.2 and 0.5, on an accuracy axis from 50 to 100 percent. Each row has three marks: the training accuracy through the mask (mean of 100 masks, hollow green circle), the training accuracy with the mask off (solid green circle) and the test accuracy (blue diamond), in percent. No dropout layer, mask on, mask off, test: seed 0 96.33, 96.33, 82.33; seed 1 83.33, 83.33, 72.00; seed 2 78.00, 78.00, 67.33; seed 3 88.00, 88.00, 77.00; seed 4 96.33, 96.33, 82.67. p = 0.1, mask on, mask off, test: seed 0 69.50, 74.33, 66.33; seed 1 56.40, 60.33, 55.33; seed 2 59.31, 65.00, 58.00; seed 3 53.07, 58.00, 56.00; seed 4 60.92, 65.67, 54.00. p = 0.2, mask on, mask off, test: seed 0 64.88, 69.67, 59.00; seed 1 56.54, 61.33, 54.67; seed 2 63.42, 72.67, 63.00; seed 3 60.45, 70.00, 61.33; seed 4 54.81, 62.00, 50.67. p = 0.5, mask on, mask off, test: seed 0 58.44, 67.00, 60.33; seed 1 57.03, 65.00, 62.00; seed 2 58.26, 66.67, 62.33; seed 3 56.11, 64.33, 53.33; seed 4 57.64, 66.67, 59.67. Without a dropout layer the mask-on and mask-off marks coincide. Two columns print mask off minus test and mask on minus test in points; the second is negative, test above the masked training figure, on 0, 1, 1 and 4 of the five seeds. Mask off minus test is positive in all 20 runs.
svg.text: Test beats training only when training runs through the mask
Seeds 0 to 4, 10,001 epochs, all measured forward-only on the final weights; differences in points.
With the mask off, training accuracy is above test accuracy in all 20 runs.
